title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Revelation 20: the dragon bound in the abyss, the thousand years, the fire from heaven, and the great white throne.

questions.text: What did the angel coming down out of heaven have in his hand?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:1 says the angel had the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

answers.text: The key of the abyss and a great chain
A sharp sickle for the harvest
A golden censer full of incense
A little book lying open

questions.text: For how long was the dragon bound?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:2 says the angel seized the dragon and bound him for a thousand years.

answers.text: Forty-two months
Three days
A thousand years
Seven years

questions.text: Why was he cast into the abyss, which was then shut and sealed over him?
questions.explanation: He was cast into the abyss and sealed in so that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years were finished.

answers.text: So that he could be judged by the elders
So that he should deceive the nations no more
So that the sea would give up its dead
So that the saints could leave the city

questions.text: The souls John saw had been beheaded for what?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:4 says he saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God.

answers.text: For refusing to pay tribute to the kings
For breaking the gates of the city
For hiding in the wilderness
For the testimony of Jesus and the word of God

questions.text: What does the text say about the second death and those who have part in the first resurrection?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:6 says that over these the second death has no power, and that they will be priests of God and of Christ.

answers.text: It will come upon them once
It has no power over them
It will be delayed a thousand years
It is hidden from them

questions.text: Which names does the text give the nations in the four corners of the earth that Satan comes out to deceive?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:8 says he comes out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, and gather them together to the war.

answers.text: Gog and Magog
Sodom and Egypt
Babylon and Nineveh
Edom and Moab

questions.text: What happened after they surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:9 says fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

answers.text: A great earthquake opened and swallowed them
They turned back and went to their own lands
Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them
The beloved city was taken and burned with fire

questions.text: What did the earth and the heaven do before the face of him who sat on the great white throne?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:11 says the earth and the heaven fled away from his face, and no place was found for them.

answers.text: They were rolled up like a scroll
They praised him with one voice
They were made new
They fled away

questions.text: On what basis were the dead standing before the throne judged?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:12 says the dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

answers.text: Out of the things written in the books
By the testimony of the twenty-four elders
By the number of years they had lived
By the word spoken from the sea

questions.text: What happened to anyone not found written in the book of life?
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:15 says that if anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

answers.text: He was shut in the abyss
He was sent out of the city
He was cast into the lake of fire
He was given to Death and Hades
